The first FOCIL devnet is one local interop away.

### Development Updates

- **ethrex**: **[Iván](https://x.com/ivanlitteri)** updated ethrex to the latest spec tests and is passing all of them. He opened a couple of PRs to execution-specs to fix the problems with the fixtures and the harness.

- **Besu**: **[Fabio](https://github.com/fab-10)** updated Besu to the latest spec tests and is passing all of them.

- **Reth**: **[Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab)** has a devnet-0 branch that is passing the Hive tests and succeeded in basic interop with other clients.

- **Nethermind**: **[Marc](https://x.com/marchhill1)** has a devnet-0 branch that is passing all the tests.

- **Teku**: **[Mehdi](https://x.com/mehdi_aouadi_)** updated its devnet-0 branch to include the recent spec changes. A local interop with Lodestar, ethrex and Besu worked fine. He is still looking into a few small timing issues and will keep the branch updated.

- **Lodestar**: **[NC](https://x.com/ensi321)** updated its devnet-0 branch to alpha.14.

- **Lighthouse**: **[Cristian](https://x.com/c_conache)** said Lighthouse is in development and most of the FOCIL work is in review.

### Spec Updates

#### CL Spec Updates

- [consensus-specs#5544](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5544), which changes the IL store key to a pair of slot and dependent root, was merged and included in alpha.14.

- [consensus-specs#5576](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5576) raises `MAX_SIGNED_INCLUSION_LIST_SIZE` to 41112 bytes and adds gossip conditions that check transaction emptiness. After a discussion, people settled on two emptiness checks: reject an IL that contains an empty transaction and ignore an IL that has no transactions.

### Testing Updates

- **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** asked the EL people whether Hive tests for `getInclusionList` are worth having. His concern is that `getInclusionList` is non-deterministic. Given a set of transactions in the mempool, no particular IL is the expected outcome.

- **[Justin](https://x.com/RoboCopsGoneMad)** asked how committed people are to having every client implement a different heuristic for censorship detection, and whether the question can be run by ACD. The mempool itself is non-deterministic, but if the heuristic were standardized, a Hive test would be reliable enough to test over.

- **[Thomas](https://x.com/soispoke)** said there is no objective function that detects censorship and that it has always been heuristics. He recalled the OFAC sanctions dashboards where everyone used their own metrics. Different rules across clients make the heuristic harder to game.

- **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** will discuss this with STEEL and bring it up at the next ACDT to get more input.

### FOCIL and Frames

- **[Thomas](https://x.com/soispoke)** shared [EIP-8369](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8369) that is aimed at understanding how FOCIL and Frames interact. VOPS (Validity-Only Partial State) is the part of the state that mempool nodes have to store so they can evaluate whether transactions are valid. It's easy with regular transactions, but it gets much harder with Frames.

- People will use the next FOCIL breakout to go over EIP-8369 with a Q&A.

### Devnet Timeline

- **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** will try local interop with Teku, Lodestar, ethrex, Besu and Nethermind, and launch devnet-0 if it goes well.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
